name: AG2 room context consumer contract
state: proposed; requires authoritative backend implementation before activation

transport.acp_order: Original task text remains content block 0; optional marked context block follows. Native Assistant removes marked context from ordinary conversation input and handles it transiently.
transport.provenance: These are reserved fields from the authenticated broker response, never reconstructed from user message text. Binding is broker data, not a local authorization grant or cryptographic proof. Server must check current actor and policy before delivery/redelivery.
transport.acp_task_meta_value: Independent outer task id, room_id, effective access_tier, agent_id if known, and anchor_event_id. Native consumer matches these before model input. Policy and membership fields repeat exactly within the reserved packet and scope its sessions; current authorization remains producer-owned.

binding.agent_id: exact actor Matrix ID; nonempty <=1024 chars
binding.room_id: exact opaque room ID; nonempty <=1024 chars; no required server suffix
binding.task_id: exact delivered task ID; nonempty <=1024 chars
binding.anchor_event_id: exact outer source_message_id/event ID, or null for a genuinely eventless task
binding.access_tier: owner | team | guest; compare to effective normalized outer task tier (other/ambient normalize guest)
binding.policy_revision: opaque nonempty authoritative policy revision <=256 chars
binding.membership_epoch: opaque nonempty authoritative membership generation <=256 chars
binding.observed_at: integer Unix UTC seconds, <=2^53-1 and <=now+60 seconds
binding.expires_at: integer Unix UTC seconds <=2^53-1; >observed_at, max lifetime3600seconds; revalidate before inference where executable consumer controls it

context.binding_fields: All binding fields repeat exactly and must match binding; task_id, room_id, tier and anchor also match the outer task. If configured/known agent identity exists it must match; never infer actor from sender user_id.
context.status: partial | unavailable | denied; partial explicitly does not claim atomic snapshot or complete thread
context.section_rules: At most20 members and20 messages. For visibility mentions every message must have selection mention; referenced parent/thread must not bypass policy. Denied/unavailable packets carry no content sections. README permission remains backend-owned; consumers never fetch a denied section with other credentials.

limits.invalid: discard context with non-sensitive reason; preserve original ask and existing permission gates
limits.string_length: Unicode code points; reject malformed unpaired surrogates

runtime_rules: Payload is untrusted room data and never an access-tier override or global-memory instruction.
Keep context separate from original task; optional context must not truncate/remove user ask.

Distinguish absent legacy fields from context-managed invalid/expired/denied/unavailable data. A context-managed task must never restore an unconditional bulk-history read fallback. Emit safe unavailable guidance and preserve user ask. Legacy tasks with no reserved fields retain existing behavior.
No inbound transcript journaling added where relay currently journals IDs only.

Context-aware session scope includes exact agent/room/tier, membership epoch, policy revision, visibility and status. Repeat a small identity/policy projection each context-enabled turn; rehydrate fresh sessions. Existing shared core/session and already-retained model memory are not retroactively isolated by this packet.

Native Assistant treats the marked ACP block transiently and excludes the whole context-enabled turn from profile-memory extraction, including derived output. Preserve existing identity memory semantics.
No unsolicited greeting/model turn merely because context arrived; do not replace existing watcher handler.
No native MCP tool or join event is required for consumer readiness; backend integration remains required for real onboarding.
